T-237 is in review: the public webinar sign-up is deployed, but the push, the live test registration and the masterclass link are still open.

decisions.decision: Build T-237 end to end on main. 1) Put isPlaceholderEmail() in cloud/src/util.ts (T-229's spec) and use it here. 2) Add POST /webinar/register in cloud/src/index.ts. CORS works like /intake and rate limiting like /cal/issue. It reads the webinar meeting currently set in the admin. Placeholder emails are refused in the /intake shape. Repeats (same meeting and email already in D1) get their stored join_url back with no Zoom call. Otherwise it makes one add-registrant call (confirmation email on, 3-per-day rule kept as in c106985), stores the row and returns the person's own join_url. 3) Hook the T-234 import: enqueue into the Tantra reminder campaigns once T-234's settings exist, otherwise log it as pending. Do not wait on T-234. 4) Serve GET /webinar/register, a form page in Backlinko voice with review links. 5) Add a probe against vendor-sim, then deploy. Put the form link on the marketing site's masterclass page and note it for Bhaskar.
decisions.why: Spec in T-237 is concrete and buildable. Rules orchestrator-autonomy and build-fully-a[redacted]. T-229's helper is part of the same build. T-234's open Tantra-sender question must not block this. T-008 already sends /webinar to /masterclass.

decisions.decision: Finish the three leftovers. 1) Push: check `git ls-remote origin main`. If the T-237 commits are missing, add a clean detached worktree, fetch, rebase only those commits onto origin/main, rerun probe-webinar-signup.mjs, then push with no force. 2) Schedule the webinar via POST /admin/api/zoom/webinar: Thursday 15 Oct 2026, 22:00 IST, 60 minutes, topic taken from the title at https://usetantra.github.io/tantra-webinar-deck. 3) Live test: register [email] (name 'Adi test') on /webinar/register. The plain address is the Zoom host and fails with 3027. Confirm the join_url, confirm a repeat makes no Zoom call, then mark it test via /signups/test. 4) Confirm webinar_signups.tantra is 'pending' for new rows even when tantra_webinar_campaign is unset; fix and redeploy from a clean worktree if not. 5) Leave the paid masterclass page unchanged; log the URL for Bhaskar. Move to review.
